rationale: Evaluating omission of required braking requires characterizing both the situation demanding braking and whether the vehicle performs that braking. H-1 establishes collision-threatening encounters, while SG-1 and FR-7 establish braking itself as the required system response. P and its declared scope address this relationship without incorporating supporting sensing, computation, communication, or failure-management mechanisms.
determining_elements: “Operational situations where braking is required” identifies the conditions under which omission must be evaluated.
“Vehicle/system behavior” includes the braking response legitimately required by T, rather than merely an external condition to be observed.
“Avoid collision with a road user or static obstacle” is supported by H-1’s hazardous event and FR-7.
The scope’s “decide and execute braking” concerns the functional braking response; it does not specify internal decision algorithms or expand P to supporting mechanisms and their timing constraints.
